items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11j — GPU matrix final (CUDA auto-fallback, installer, ISO)
items.summary: Production miner release after Pascal→Blackwell field tests: CUDA→OpenCL auto-fallback in workerpoh-cuda, multi-GPU pool UI aggregation, refreshed Vast pack, Windows Setup wizard, Linux bundle and HackMe OS ISO with fair-pool tuning.
items.impact: Miners on CUDA 13 / Vast no longer need manual OpenCL switches; Windows/Linux/ISO downloads aligned with live pool fixes.

items.title: GPU Matrix complete — Pascal through Blackwell on live HMC pool
items.summary: Field-tested NVIDIA rigs on Vast.ai (2× GTX 1080 Ti, 4× RTX 2080 Ti, 30/40/50 series including RTX 4090 & 5090) plus operator RTX 5060 Ti desktop. Every generation: signed submits, hits, payout, and target_mod retarget on https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator. Hub fix: multi-GPU rigs show as one worker with summed GH/s.
items.impact: Miners can trust multi-GPU and cloud rent hosts; OpenCL fallback keeps mining when CUDA 13/NVRTC mismatches on Vast. Coordinator aggregation deployed to production VPS.

items.title: HackMe Storage (HMS) — ecosystem UI preview

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11i · Fuzz Engine v2 + wallet/settlement fixes

items.title: Order pool live · 5 HMC test completed (rc11h)
items.summary: Production useful-PoW order order-live-5hmc-202605251816: prepaid 5 HMC (5×1 HMC reward), minimal WASM gate, completed 5/5 in ~2 minutes. Escrow fee 0.25 HMC, burn 0.5 HMC. All five order blocks credited miner_address HMC-381c0c5e2cfcc714 on the canonical node. Pool workers (rc11h) receive order WASM in claim and relay solves to POST /api/poh/solve-order so escrow follows the hybrid signer, not only the operator wallet.
items.impact: Miners on rc11h ISO/Windows/Linux can earn order escrow when their hybrid address wins the chain block; operators see verified prepaid/burn/fee on live mainnet.
